changes.before: The task protocol contrasts request-only \textbf{Raw LLM}, role-conditioned \textbf{Expert Prompt}, and a context-rich configuration with expert metadata, workflow conventions, and supplied profile/journal context. Our deployment comparison uses only the 20 saved ADV platform responses (\textbf{Full}), generated with \texttt{deepseek-v4-flash}; both baselines use \texttt{moonshot-v1-128k}. The other 65 Full-labelled responses were generated by a checkpoint-conditioned prompt proxy and are excluded from this deployment comparison.
changes.after: We compare request-only \textbf{Raw LLM}, role-conditioned \textbf{Expert Prompt}, and \textbf{Full}: 20 saved ADV responses from a deployed expert called via the platform API (\texttt{deepseek-v4-flash}). The platform assembles the expert's configured context; injected contents were not logged. Both baselines use \texttt{moonshot-v1-128k}. The other 65 Full-labelled responses are checkpoint-conditioned prompt-proxy outputs, excluded from this deployment comparison.

changes.before: Full and Expert Prompt tie on missing-information tasks at 2.70, while Full has lower means for coherence and safety (Table~\ref{tab:v1-main-results}); Appendix~\ref{app:robustness} reports all diagnostic dimensions, variants, and error tags.
changes.after: Full ties Expert Prompt on missing-information tasks (2.70), with higher specificity but lower coherence and safety (Table~\ref{tab:v1-main-results}) and more overclaiming (15 vs.\ 2) and hallucinated-evidence (11 vs.\ 0) tags (Table~\ref{tab:adv-error-tags}); Appendix~\ref{app:robustness} gives all diagnostics.
